label: Defaults and named overrides
subgoals: Start from the parameter defaults in the module header
Replace only the parameters the instance overrides by name
Evaluate localparams and port widths with the instance's values

label: Values passed down the hierarchy
subgoals: Resolve the parent's parameters before the child's
Evaluate each override expression with the parent's values
Create one specialization per distinct parameter set

label: Positional overrides
subgoals: Map positional values onto parameters in declaration order
Recompute derived values after the mapping
Prefer named overrides to avoid order coupling
